touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Cranwell qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST ANDREW and Cranwell village cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Cranwell: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Cranwell offers CHURCH OF ST ANDREW, Cranwell village cross, VILLAGE CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST ANDREW
